extName.message: Chrono – Finish Time & Speed for YouTube
extName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser's extension list and the stores.

extShortName.description: Short extension name. Also the accessible name of the Panel.

extDescription.message: See how long a YouTube video really takes at your speed, and when you'll finish.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown in the browser's extension list.

remaining.description: Remaining watch time at the current speed, e.g. "12:30 left at 1.5×".

finishTime.description: The clock time at which the video will end, e.g. "ends 3:45 PM".

playerBadgeFinishTime.description: The Player badge: the video's finish time, shown after the player's own time display ("0:03 / 10:34 · ends 3:45 PM"). The dot separates it from YouTube's times.

pausedForAd.description: Shown in place of the remaining and finish time while YouTube plays an ad, when Chrono pauses its calculations.

live.description: Shown in place of the remaining and finish time on a live stream or a premiere, which have no fixed end.

slower.description: Accessible name of the Panel's − button, which lowers the speed by 0.25×.

faster.description: Accessible name of the Panel's + button, which raises the speed by 0.25×.

details.description: Accessible name of the Panel's expandable details area and of the button that expands and collapses it.

speedTable.description: Accessible name of the list of common speeds, each with its remaining watch time and finish time.

speedTableRow.description: Accessible name of a speed table row, which applies that speed when clicked, e.g. "1.5×: 8:20 left, ends 3:08 PM".

chapterScope.description: Label of the Chapter scope, which shows the chapter the playhead is in. Also its accessible name.

chapterSpeedTable.description: Accessible name of the Chapter scope's list of common speeds, each with the chapter's remaining watch time and finish time.

playlistSpeedTable.description: Accessible name of the Playlist scope's list of common speeds, each with the playlist's remaining watch time and finish time up to the target entry.

moreActions.description: Accessible name of the Panel's ⋮ menu button and of the menu it opens.

settings.description: Heading of Chrono's settings in the toolbar popup.

playerBadge.description: Setting: whether the video's finish time shows next to the player's own time display.

clockFormat.description: Setting: how finish times are written.

clockFormatAuto.description: Clock format choice: follow the browser's language and region.

clockFormat12h.description: Clock format choice: times like 3:45 PM.

showChapterScope.description: Setting: whether the Panel shows the current chapter's remaining and finish time on a video with chapters.

showPlaylistScope.description: Setting: whether the Panel shows the remaining and finish time for the rest of the playlist.

playlistScope.description: Heading of the Playlist scope: the current video plus the following playlist entries up to the target entry.

playlistTargetEntry.description: Label of the input that chooses the last playlist entry the Playlist scope counts, by its number in the playlist.

playlistPartial.description: Note in the Playlist scope when YouTube has loaded only part of the playlist, e.g. "first 200 of 412 counted".

playlistUnavailable.description: Note in the Playlist scope: how many private, deleted or otherwise unavailable entries it skips, e.g. "3 unavailable".

playlistShuffle.message: Shuffle is on, so no playlist estimate
playlistShuffle.description: Shown in place of the Playlist scope's times while the playlist's Shuffle button is on.

videoTarget.description: Accessible name of the Video scope's target: the finish time or watch time the viewer sets for the rest of the video, and the speed it needs.

chapterTarget.description: Accessible name of the Chapter scope's target: the finish time or watch time the viewer sets for the rest of the current chapter, and the speed it needs.

playlistTarget.description: Accessible name of the Playlist scope's target: the finish time or watch time the viewer sets for the rest of the playlist up to the target entry, and the speed it needs.

target.description: Label of the list that chooses a scope's target: none, a finish time or a watch time.

targetNone.description: Target choice: the scope has no target.

targetFinishTime.description: Target choice: finish the scope by a clock time, as in "Done by 3:30 PM".

targetWatchTime.description: Target choice: the viewer has an amount of watch time for the rest of the scope, as in "I have 0 h 45 min".

targetHour.description: Accessible name of the hour field of a finish-time target.

targetMinute.description: Accessible name of the minute field of a finish-time target.

targetPeriod.description: Accessible name of the list that chooses AM or PM for a finish-time target, on a 12-hour clock.

targetHours.description: Accessible name of the hours field of a watch-time target.

targetMinutes.description: Accessible name of the minutes field of a watch-time target.

targetHoursUnit.description: Short unit shown after the hours field of a watch-time target, as in "1 h 30 min".

targetMinutesUnit.description: Short unit shown after the minutes field of a watch-time target, as in "1 h 30 min".

requiredSpeed.description: The speed at which the scope's remaining meets its target, e.g. "Needs 1.35×".

requiredSpeedTooFast.description: The speed a target needs, rounded to 0.05×, when it is faster than YouTube can play, e.g. "Needs 2.6× · beyond YouTube's 2× limit".

requiredSpeedTooSlow.description: Shown in place of the required speed when a target needs a speed slower than YouTube can play, e.g. "Slower than YouTube's 0.25× limit".

targetPassed.description: Shown in place of the required speed when the target's finish time is in the past.

targetNoTime.message: Choose a watch time above zero
targetNoTime.description: Shown in place of the required speed when the target's watch time is zero.

targetFinished.description: Shown in place of the required speed when the scope has already ended.

applySpeed.description: Button that sets YouTube's speed to the speed a target needs.

applySpeedLabel.description: Accessible name of the button that sets YouTube's speed to the speed a target needs, e.g. "Apply 1.35×".

panelStartsExpanded.description: Setting: whether the Panel's details are open when a watch page opens.

playlistSummary.description: Setting: whether Chrono adds its one-line total to playlist pages. Also the accessible name of that line.

playlistSummaryTotal.description: Playlist summary: the content time of every available entry, e.g. "4h 12m total".

playlistSummaryAtSpeed.description: Playlist summary: how long the playlist takes at the viewer's YouTube speed, e.g. "2h 48m at 1.5×".

playlistSummaryUnavailable.description: Playlist summary: how many entries are deleted, private or otherwise unavailable, and not counted, e.g. "3 unavailable".

playlistSummaryPartial.description: Playlist summary: YouTube has loaded only part of the playlist, so only that part is counted, e.g. "first 100 of 412 counted".

playlistSummaryCounted.description: Playlist summary: Chrono can't read the length of some entries, such as the one YouTube is playing, so the total leaves them out, e.g. "38 of 39 counted".

playlistSummaryJoin.description: Playlist summary: joins its parts, in the style of YouTube's own stats, e.g. "4h 12m total · 3 unavailable".

hoursMinutes.description: A length in hours and minutes, e.g. "4h 12m".

hours.description: A length in whole hours, e.g. "4h".

minutes.description: A length in minutes, under an hour, e.g. "48m".

popupNote.message: Chrono works on YouTube watch and playlist pages.
popupNote.description: Note in the toolbar popup saying where Chrono shows up.

supportChrono.description: Link in the Panel's ⋮ menu and the toolbar popup to a page where the viewer can tip Chrono's developer.

getHelp.description: Link in the Panel's ⋮ menu and the toolbar popup to Chrono's help page, pre-filled with Chrono's version, the browser and the OS.

reportIt.description: Link in the Panel's ⋮ menu and the toolbar popup to Chrono's help page, pre-filled with what Chrono detected on the YouTube page as well.
